candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official fact or deterministic January-to-July rounded-snapshot metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.long_horizon_snapshot: January and July BDUK values are rounded management-information snapshots limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag and scope changes; derived long-horizon metrics do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability, physical delivery during the interval or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.gap_metric: A contracted-minus-built gap is an arithmetic relationship between two rounded snapshot fields. Its change can reflect scope revisions as well as reported build changes and is not a backlog forecast, parcel count or milestone assessment.
scope_guards.switching_scope: Ofcom mobile-switching guidance describes standard consumer processes; charges, eligibility, timing and number retention depend on the account, provider and case facts.
scope_guards.unwanted_scope: Call-display, blocking and filtering tools reduce risk but do not prove that a particular caller is genuine or fraudulent and may also block legitimate withheld calls.
scope_guards.portability_scope: Number-portability information summarises regulatory and industry arrangements; it is not legal advice and does not prove that a particular port request will succeed.
scope_guards.scam_scope: Scam-prevention guidance describes protective steps and reporting routes; it does not identify a specific contact as fraudulent or replace police, provider or bank assessment.
